recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一顆大型前紅血球母細胞，核內染色質被均質淡染、玻璃樣的病毒包涵體取代，核膜周邊染色質濃縮成一圈（lantern cell）；周圍可見含棕色含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞，提示微小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Central enlarged pronormoblast with a large nucleus showing a pale, glassy eosinophilic-to-amphophilic intranuclear inclusion
Chromatin marginated to the nuclear membrane, giving a rim-like appearance and a small eccentric chromatin clump
Scattered macrophages with golden-brown hemosiderin pigment
Hematopoietic cells of mixed lineage, with relatively few maturing erythroid precursors in this field
Adipocytes and a stromal/vascular structure crossing the field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marrow with fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic cells, among which is an enlarged pronormoblast containing a large nucleus with a pale, glassy intranuclear inclusion and marginated chromatin. Maturing erythroid precursors appear reduced in this field, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection with erythroid hypoplasia; parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or ISH is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CMV inclusions are 'owl-eye' with a dense eosinophilic inclusion and halo plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions in endothelial/stromal cells rather than erythroid precursors.
Consists of sheets of proerythroblasts, not isolated large cells with glassy nuclear inclusions.
Megaloblasts show open chromatin across maturing stages with hypercellular erythroid hyperplasia rather than an inclusion with erythroid hypoplasia.
HRS cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli and a mixed inflammatory background, and are CD30+/CD15+.
